newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Dutch, Belgian markets now overbought - JP Morgan.
newsitem.headline: Dutch, Belgian markets now overbought - JP Morgan.

text.p: JP Morgan said on Friday it had assigned what it called an overall overbought status for the Belgian and Dutch equities markets.
"The current rise, especially for the Dutch market, is unfounded...it does not reflect prospective 1997 price/earnings for both markets," a spokesman told Reuters from London.

The Brussels Bel-20 share index .BFX was down 15 points at 2,472 at 1205 GMT on Friday after chalking up a record close of 2,488 points on Thursday. Dealers said the index was toppish at around 2,500 points and ready for a correction.
Since the start of the year the index has gained some 900 points.

In Amsterdam the AEX index .AEX was holding comfortably above 900 points, supported by retail demand after setting an intraday high of 911. Since the start of 1997 the index has risen by more than 400 points.
